headline: Give intelligence
intro: Faros helps platform teams turn company data, tools, and infrastructure into reusable building blocks for AI-built apps and agents. Give teams a foundation to build on—not another one-off setup.
governBody: Workspaces scope resources and access. People and agents reach the same resources through APIs and MCP.
close: The foundation is yours. What will you build?
footer: An open-source control plane for applications, agents, and infrastructure.
